title: "Included launch description missing required argument" in ROS 2: launch_arguments, .items(), argument leaks, typos and booleans, measured
excerpt: Why a required DeclareLaunchArgument fails even when the parent declares it or you pass it on the CLI, what a missing .items() prints, how values leak through IncludeLaunchDescription and GroupAction, and why use_sim_tme:=true is ignored. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
